answer.thought: Ramesh stands by with that particular stillness that indicates he has heard enough and is waiting for a command that does not exist. I am not a master, nor is he a slave, yet the interaction requires a form. I will dismiss him with a nod, returning to the text on the Oriental world; the caste system is a rigidity that prevents the spirit from moving into the universal, a static nature that must be overcome to reach freedom.
